title: was / were going to

examples.en: He said he was going to visit his grandparents.
examples.zh: 他说他打算去看望祖父母。

examples.en: We were going to have a picnic, but it rained.
examples.zh: 我们本来打算去野餐，但下雨了。

guess.question: 第二句里的野餐，最后去了没有？

options.text: 没去成——计划被下雨打断了
options.feedback: 对！was/were going to 常常暗含“本来打算，但没做成”。
不对——后半句 but it rained 说明计划没实现。
不对——were 说明这是过去的事。

rule.rule: 从过去的某个时刻看打算要做的事，常暗含“本来打算、结果没做成”
rule.formula: was / were going to + 动词原形

anchors.en: He said he was going to help me with my homework.
anchors.zh: 他说他打算帮我做作业。
anchors.note: 过去版本的 be going to

anchors.en: We were going to play basketball, but it began to rain.
anchors.zh: 我们本来打算打篮球，但天开始下雨了。

trap.wrong: He said he is going to come.
trap.right: He said he was going to come.
trap.why: 主句是过去时，be 动词要跟着退成 was/were。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住：was/were going to 是“过去的打算”，句子里出现 but 时，往往就是没做成。

check.stem: She said she ____ visit her aunt the next week.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，is 要变 was
主句过去时，will 要变 would 或用 was going to

check.explanation: 主句 said 是过去时，打算用 was going to visit。

check.stem: We ____ (have) a sports meeting, but the weather was bad.

options.distractor: had 表示开成了，与 but 后面的意思矛盾

check.explanation: but 说明运动会没开成，是“本来打算”，用 were going to have。

options.text: He said he is going to help me.
options.distractor: 主句过去时，is 要变 was

options.text: He said he was going to help me.
He said he would going to help me.
options.distractor: would 后面不能接 going to

options.text: He said he will going to help me.

check.explanation: 过去时主句后表示打算，用 was going to + 动词原形。
